newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy plans to project bigger image for its films.
newsitem.headline: Italy plans to project bigger image for its films.

text.p: The foreign ministry said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Italy's national film body to project a bigger international image for the country's cinematic output.
It said in a statement the first initiative would be to show a season of Italian movies from last month's Venice film festival in France and Spain by the end of the year.

A retrospective of the late Federico Fellini, director of much-loved movies including "La Dolce Vita" and "La Strada", will be staged in Thessaloniki, Greece, when it becomes the European city of culture next year.

Italian film seasons, including one of the films of Bernardo Bertolucci who made waves with "Last Tango in Paris" and has recently released "Stealing Beauty", are also planned in China, the United States, India, Latin America and Australia.

Italy's once vibrant movie industry has suffered in recent years from the onslaught of Hollywood hits. The ministry said it hoped the initiative would "relaunch the quality cinema of yesterday and today by showing the best Italian productions".
